OpsBot: INCIDENT ALERT: elevated RPM on model-family 'marlin-7b' (sev3). 90th p95 latency + error spike. Auto-mitigation kicked: per-model throttle candidate list generated. https://runbook/redwood/incidents/2112345678 :rotating_light:
Maya (oncall): looking. traffic trending up from a few big customers, ~3x normal for marlin-7b. errors are 429/503 combos. can we carve capacity or lower RPM for marlin-7b only?
Ajay: agree — prefer targeted RPM cap rather than global throttles. can someone confirm which pools are serving marlin-7b? pinging @Sanjay for routing map.
Sanjay: marlin-7b served from pool-gamma and pool-delta, fallback to marlin-7b-quantized if gamma overloaded. current allocations: gamma 1200 tpm, delta 600 tpm. spike appears to originate from gamma (see metrics).
Maya (oncall): customer impact: support reports increased failures for 3 paying customers (CS case #20122, #20123, #20124). notify CS. Eli, can you confirm which customers and if SLA impacted?
Eli: confirmed, two SMBs and one larger account experiencing elevated latency; no data loss but failures cause retries. CS notified customers and asked to expect short mitigation window.
Carla: recommendation: temporary RPM cap on marlin-7b at pool level + increase fallback weight to marlin-7b-quantized for new sessions. Also enable request-sampling to log failing payloads.
Ajay: proposed exact actions: 1) apply per-model RPM cap: gamma: 120rps -> 80rps (equiv rpm calc), delta: 60rps -> 40rps. 2) bump fallback routing weight by 30% to quantized variant. 3) enable short-term prefix-KV cache bypass for heavy long-history requests.
Maya (oncall): I'm going to execute the RPM cap for gamma first, then monitor. Ajay please be ready to rollback.
Ajay: acknowledged. watchlist: p95 latency, 5xx rate, queued requests.
Maya (oncall): running command now:
```
# apply per-model rpm caps
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/admin/quotas \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"marlin-7b","pool":"gamma","rpm":4800}'
```
Maya (oncall): done. See quick logs: throttle-rule created id=throttle-2112345678-gamma :hammer_and_wrench:
OpsBot: ACTION LOG: quota rule throttle-2112345678-gamma applied by Maya at 2112345692.
Sanjay: gamma's 429s dropped by ~40% within 60s, p95 down a bit. delta still spiking. recommend applying delta cap next.
Maya (oncall): applying delta cap now.
Maya (oncall): applied delta cap id=throttle-2112345715-delta. OpsBot: ACTION LOG recorded.
Ajay: routing bump to quantized variant next. command:
```
# increase fallback weight
POST /api/v1/routing/policies/adjust
{ "model_family":"marlin","variant":"quantized","weight_delta":30 }
```
Ajay: applied. routing change propagated to edge within ~20s.
Eli: CS update queued: "We've applied temporary rate limits to reduce failures and routed more traffic to a lower-precision variant to preserve availability. We're monitoring and will update in 15m."
Maya (oncall): monitoring window 15m started. metrics look stable so far. overall errors down 55%, CPU on gamma lower.
Carla: note — we should create a post-change eval for quality on quantized variant to validate customer-visible regressions. schedule A/B checks.
Ajay: agreed — creating an eval job against the live traffic sample. if quality drop > 7% on key prompts, we'll roll back routing.
Maya (oncall): handoff to next oncall at 2112346000. @Ajay you're primary for follow-ups. leaving this thread open for the next 30m. :white_check_mark:
OpsBot: Handoff recorded. Next oncall: Ajay.
Ajay: acknowledged handoff. continuing to monitor; will escalate to eng-runtime if we see sustained p50 increase or tail 5xxs rebound.
Carla: thanks team. postmortem ticket created: INC-2112345678, assign eng-sre + eng-runtime.
Eli: CS will send follow-up note to impacted customers once stability confirmed.
Maya (oncall): closing active mitigation steps. leaving runbook links and commands in incident ticket. :lock:
